title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: GOAL implements ICSP in Northern and Eastern Uganda with a focus on Maternal, Newborn, Child Health and Nutrition (MNCHN), food security, and increasing sustainable access to clean and safe water through improved operations and maintenance of rural water points. The programme primarily targets women and girls, with a particular emphasis on pregnant and lactating women, and with consideration for vulnerable households and people with disabilities. In 2024, ICSP supported 39 health facilities and approximately 120 villages in Northern Uganda. ICSP also supported the water supply component in Eastern Uganda. 133,411 people were reached through GOAL’s ICSP in 2024.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 3: People Have Food & Nutrition Security. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Collaborating with system actors to train and support VSLAs on climate smart and climate adapted agricultural practices (including agrecological and egeneratve practices) for food production, post-harvest handling and value addition.
